layout_details.content: ## 9.2 Attributes
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: This standard defines the attributes for the two specific NISO STS Tag Sets. By default, all attributes are included in both Tag Sets; the few attributes that are used only in the Extended Tag Set are so identified.
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: Attribute entries contain:
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - The XML Name of the attribute, e.g., @specific-use
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - The informational name of the attribute, e.g. "Specific Use"
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - A description of the attribute, e.g., "Specifies distinctions in the applicability of a particular element".
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - Then, for each element or group of elements in these Tag Sets in which the attribute is identically defined, there is a block of usage information with required or suggested values and other information. Note that:
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - Some attributes are used on many elements.
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - Some attributes are used in the same way on all elements in a Tag Set, but some may have different optionality or values when used on different elements in the same Tag Set.
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - For each usage block, the attribute entry contains:
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - A list of the elements for which this block of information is relevant.
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - A restrictions statement, which may have any of the following values:
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - "This attribute may be used if the element is used." Meaning that the attribute is optional, and there is no default.
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - "This attribute must be used if the element is used." Meaning that the attribute is required, and there is no default.
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - "This attribute must have the value [quoted actual value given]."
layout_details.label: text

layout_details.content: - A description of the allowed contents of the attribute, which will either be a description of the type of information allowed in the attribute or a table of allowed values and their meanings.
layout_details.label: text
